claims.claim_text: Training VCS / JS with ν ∝ detector score (rank log ν + 2f) raises all-proposal Acc@0.5 by +2.1 to +2.7 over uniform-ν training
claims.assumptions: DEV reused (exploratory); SigLIP 2 B/16; RefCOCOg / RefCOCO+; 3 seeds; detector-proposal candidates
claims.allowed_conclusion: the score-reference model with its corrected rank is about 2 points more accurate than the uniform model with plain cosine
claims.not_implied: that the estimator law (rather than detector information) causes the gain

claims.claim_text: Giving the uniform models the same detector information at test time (λ chosen on CAL) matches the score-reference gain
claims.assumptions: DEV reused (exploratory); SigLIP 2 B/16; RefCOCOg / RefCOCO+; 3 seeds; detector-proposal candidates
claims.experiment: R4-VL2 C3b (fixed λ) and R5-10 F1 C2 +0.20 / +0.69, intervals contain 0 (f243936)
claims.allowed_conclusion: no detectable training effect beyond test-time fusion and CAL calibration, in total with model selection
claims.not_implied: absence of any training effect (F2 not identifiable; containment is not equivalence)

claims.claim_text: VCS(ν) − set softmax contains 0 on both datasets (frozen wording 'closes the gap')
claims.assumptions: DEV reused (exploratory); SigLIP 2 B/16; RefCOCOg / RefCOCO+; 3 seeds; detector-proposal candidates
claims.not_implied: equality with softmax; with equal test-time information softmax still leads on RefCOCO+ (C3a −1.36; F1 −1.07)

claims.claim_text: Distribution softmax (uniform target over valid boxes, all real proposals in the denominator) vs set softmax
claims.assumptions: DEV reused (exploratory); SigLIP 2 B/16; RefCOCOg / RefCOCO+; 3 seeds; detector-proposal candidates
claims.allowed_conclusion: no detectable effect of the uniform-over-valid-boxes requirement on softmax accuracy

claims.claim_text: VCS / matched JS trail distribution softmax by 2.1–3.2 points
claims.assumptions: DEV reused (exploratory); SigLIP 2 B/16; RefCOCOg / RefCOCO+; 3 seeds; detector-proposal candidates
claims.allowed_conclusion: the pairwise objectives' gap is not explained by the multiple-valid-box target

claims.claim_text: The VCS − softmax deficit exists on queries with exactly one valid box
claims.assumptions: DEV reused (exploratory); SigLIP 2 B/16; RefCOCOg / RefCOCO+; 3 seeds; detector-proposal candidates; strata overlap in images; image bootstrap
claims.allowed_conclusion: multiplicity is not the main cause; it adds on RefCOCO+ at k >= 4

claims.claim_text: With the same query and target box, the deficit grows with the number of nested distractors
claims.assumptions: DEV reused (exploratory); SigLIP 2 B/16; RefCOCOg / RefCOCO+; 3 seeds; detector-proposal candidates; fixed query pool with >= 31 invalid candidates
claims.experiment: R5-20C: VCS − E −0.28 → −1.01 → −2.62 → −3.50 (1 / 7 / 31 / all; RefCOCOg), similar on RefCOCO+
claims.allowed_conclusion: the deficit is a many-candidate competition effect
claims.not_implied: the same curve on the full task population

claims.claim_text: The model's own top wrong box takes 45–50 % of the wrong-box score gradient under VCS / JS and 52–67 % under the softmaxes
claims.assumptions: DEV reused (exploratory); SigLIP 2 B/16; RefCOCOg / RefCOCO+; 3 seeds; detector-proposal candidates; score-level derivatives of fixed CAL-selected models
claims.allowed_conclusion: softmax objectives focus more of the score gradient on the top competitor

claims.claim_text: The detector-score reference doubles the reference mass on the self-top wrong box but barely changes its gradient share
claims.assumptions: DEV reused (exploratory); SigLIP 2 B/16; RefCOCOg / RefCOCO+; 3 seeds; detector-proposal candidates
claims.allowed_conclusion: re-weighting Q does not translate into gradient focus on the most dangerous candidate
claims.not_implied: that no ν could do so

claims.claim_text: A longer shared schedule (20 vs 10 epochs) favours the estimator objectives (given boxes)
claims.assumptions: VL3 given-box setting; 12 cells; 3 seeds; DEV reused
claims.allowed_conclusion: pre-fixed: 'a longer shared schedule favours the estimator objectives by 0.35'; the 10-epoch tie stays primary

claims.claim_text: The VCS − JS posterior gap (gaussian d 20, I 6) forms on the optimisation path from initialisation
claims.assumptions: one oracle condition; 3 seeds; N 4096 and 16384
claims.allowed_conclusion: from the same JS start J is not better than JS; J overfits faster at N 4096 and ends slightly worse at N 16384
claims.not_implied: a general solver result; a new algorithm

claims.claim_text: Cross-pair estimates of J(T) need the U-statistic jackknife (or image resampling); pair-iid SEs are invalid both ways
claims.assumptions: fixed critic; iid base observations / images
